prepNotes.en: 1) Pan medium heat + little oil. 2) Arrange dumplings. 3) Add a splash of water, cover until bottoms crisp (ice-flower). 4) Serve with dip. Watch video for timing.
prepNotes.fil: 1) Medium heat + konting oil. 2) Ilagay ang dumplings. 3) Magdagdag ng konting tubig, takpan hanggang crispy. 4) Serve with toyo/suka. Tingnan ang video sa timing.
prepNotes.zh: 中火少油煎餃，加水蓋蓋至底部冰花，配醬。

prepNotes.en: Simmer kimchi + water/stock, add tofu gently, optional meat, crack egg on top. Don't boil tofu hard. Video shows seasoning.
prepNotes.fil: Pakuluan ang kimchi + sabaw, dahan-dahang ilagay ang tofu, optional meat, itlog sa ibabaw. Huwag masyadong pakuluan ang tofu.
prepNotes.zh: 泡菜加水煮，輕放豆腐，可加肉，打蛋，勿猛滾豆腐。

prepNotes.en: Stir-fry beans first until tender, push aside, scramble eggs, mix. Season lightly.
prepNotes.fil: Igisa muna ang beans, isaisantabi, lutuin ang itlog, paghaluin. Konting seasoning.
prepNotes.zh: 先炒豆角至熟，再炒蛋混合調味。

prepNotes.en: Watch the YouTube/Instagram video for heat & timing (often Cantonese). Prep: wash/cut ingredients first. Cook soup gently. Ask Sir/Mum if unsure about seasoning.
prepNotes.fil: Panoorin ang video para sa init at timing (madalas Cantonese). Ihanda muna ang sangkap. Lutuin ang sabaw nang dahan-dahan. Tanungin si Sir/Mum kung hindi sure sa lasa.
prepNotes.zh: 影片多為廣東話，先備好材料。慢火煲湯。調味不肯定請問 Sir/Mum。
